The 3D Morton code $M_3(x, y, z)$ for a block at $(x, y, z)$ is defined as [S1]:

The claim accurately reflects the definitions and explanations provided in Source [S1]. Specifically, [S1] defines the 3D Morton code as M3(x,y,z) = Σ_{b=0}^{B-1} (4y_b + 2x_b + z_b)2^{3b} with interleaved bits y_{B-1}x_{B-1}z_{B-1}...y_0x_0z_0, and the 2D Morton code as M2(u,v) = Σ_{b=0}^{B-1} (2u_b + v_b)2^{2b} with interleaved bits u_{B-1}v_{B-1}...u_0v_0. It also states that the mapping is (u,v) = M2^{-1}(rank(M3(x,y,z))) and explains that prioritizing the y-axis accommodates standing human figures to maintain spatio-temporal coherence.
